info.text:
Your online match just landed in the hospital. That's the scam.
The FBI logged $929 million in romance scam losses in 2025, up about 38% from 2024.
In FTC data for 2022, the most common romance-scam lie was "sick, hurt or in jail."
Example: $500 + $2,500 + $6,000 = $9,000 to someone never met in person.
The FTC says only scammers ask for payment by gift card, wire or crypto.
Sources: FBI IC3 2025 Internet Crime Report; FTC Data Spotlight (Feb 2023).
News and education, not financial advice.
